label: PHASE_S_POSE_DECISION_V1
rationale: Pose estimation requires reliable diver detection and localization as a prerequisite. Current perception pipeline achieves 0% IoU50 detection recall on INTERNAL_EVAL and 8.3% on DEVELOPMENT. SAM2 tracking collapses in 5/6 dives. Adding pose estimation to a failed detection/tracking pipeline adds noise without diagnostic value. Re-evaluate when perception achieves >=50% within-tolerance rate.
